documented_diagnosis.name: Nevus
documented_diagnosis.evidence: Clinical diagnosis by the dermatologists who collected the dataset; not biopsied (PAD-UFES-20).

teaching_points: Benign moles are usually symmetric, with one even colour and a smooth, regular border, as here.
Moles can grow slowly in young adults. A mole that changes quickly, looks unlike your others, bleeds or itches deserves review.

look_alikes.name: Melanoma
look_alikes.note: Asymmetric, unevenly coloured, irregular or changing.

look_alikes.name: Seborrheic keratosis
look_alikes.note: Stuck-on look with a waxy or warty surface.

look_alikes.name: Dermatofibroma
look_alikes.note: A firm brownish bump that dimples when pinched.
